  • (Sec. 116) No less frequently than every six months, states must redetermine the eligibility of adult enrollees made newly eligible for Medicaid by PPACA. (This was, and still is, a huge scam in almost all welfare programs in the US. The enrollee shows one check stub to the social worker when applying for a program, usually the lowest within the date range specified by the program in question, and gets benefits based on that unusually low check. And no other check stubs are requested for years upon years, even when the person earns more money.)
  • (Sec. 133) Health insurers must increase premiums by 30% for one year for enrollees in the individual or small group market who had a break in coverage of more than 62 days in the previous year.
